Group rides in Virginia

31 recurring group rides around Virginia: 23 road, 9 social, 6 mountain bike. 17 roll on weeknights, 14 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Tuesday Night Ride (NoVA Casual Bicycling Group) in Arlington — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Saturday Group Ride (Tripower Cycling Club) runs a 22-25 mph (drop); B 18-20 mph (no-drop); C 16-18 mph on the club page.
